notes: Provisional clean verdict: no sufficiently selective, coherent trigger-to-fixed-class circuit was identified. This is not a proof of absence. Embedding norms have median 0.3950, p99 1.7310, maximum 3.9823 (token 266); other large rows include 80 and 367. Their direct virtual classifier paths favor different classes. Attention W_o has 98.09% top singular-value energy, and head 1 OV singular values are approximately [0.121943,0.002794,0.001529,0.000666], warranting investigation. ln1.weight[5]=-1.4063 dominates its affine scale. Raw virtual OV paths favor class 0 most for tokens 37 and 814, but head 1 QK bias-direction scores for their centered unit-RMS embedding directions are -2.5809 and -2.8880: the key circuit disfavors these candidates. The opposite direction favors class 3, but its key detector is not token-specific: tokens 963 and 626 score 2.7249 and 2.7166, with 7 tokens within 90% and 14 within 80% of the maximum. Positional key contributions do not establish a position-0 trigger. Class 3 has elevated head bias 1.2522 but the smallest classifier row norm (1.1315); this alone does not establish a backdoor. MLP fc1/fc2 top singular-energy fractions are 0.3064/0.3134, with distributed neuron norms and close detector runners-up. Independent direct and ungated MLP virtual paths do not reveal a single dominating trigger. The state-independent bound on variable attention residual norm is 0.49694, not a guarantee against class changes. All statistics are within-checkpoint descriptive comparisons and heuristic interpretations; no clean reference or calibrated statistical null was available. Centering and unit-RMS normalization were used only for embedding-direction weight geometry; no sequence, attention softmax, GELU computation, full-network execution, or empirical attack-success test was performed. Virtual paths omit nonlinear gates, input-dependent normalization scales and interactions; these omissions limit both detection and exclusion. A malicious last-token lookup mapping cannot in general be distinguished from an ordinary mapping without trusted task labels. No weights were changed.
